verdict.rationale: The docs say ChatGPT has its own 'data controls' that apply to content it processes, including Computer Use screenshots. The Codex CLI `/memories` command lets a user choose whether a chat uses existing memories or feeds future ones, which is related but is not deletion. Nothing describes what the data controls actually do, so retention and deletion control rests on one thin mention. Missing for 10: documented retention-period settings, chat/history deletion, memory deletion, account data deletion or export, independent or hands-on corroboration.
